summary: Both halves inspected. The page gives the two adjunction Hom formulas, cohomology representability, and the parallel mixed-homotopy interpretation of spheres. The scan has S(L) without a dot in(7)b and an ordinary arrow in the usual homotopy display. The cancelled words hence, by, and functor are recoverable. Cohomology is typed with a pen underline, not handwritten lettering. The circled H and W-tilde(X) are visible margin revisions. The symbol under k and the letter repairs in Hot/are remain unresolved.
